title: Every written CST stamp is checked against the clock
why: Triage stamps ran 11-16 min ahead of now-central from about 09:50 to 09:57 CST Nov 13 (audit 10:01 CST). That covered the handoff header, a push time and a runner message. The message-time hook checks send_message only, and caught one at 10:00 CST. Handoff headers, step notes and page reply stamps are not checked.
note: Fix: extend the message-time check (its one home) to handoff writes and roadmap step note stamps, with the same 1-minute limit. Done when: a test writes a handoff stamped 10 minutes ahead and is refused. Incident 11:11 CST Nov 13 (coordinator): batch runner 11 stamped a message 11:15 CST at 11:11 CST, 4 minutes ahead; a second session with the same drift. Incident 11:14 CST Nov 13 (coordinator): triage wrote "Routed at 11:16 CST" in a page thread reply at 11:14 CST, without reading now-central. Second incident (retrospective 11:38 CST Nov 13): from about 11:30 to 11:39 CST triage wrote stamps up to 68 minutes ahead of the clock (for example "12:46 CST" at 11:38 CST) in notes, rulings, page replies and chat headers, by estimating the time instead of reading now-central at the send. The retrospective's guard message-time-matches-clock refused that drift on its sends and let triage's through. Corrected in place 11:40 CST: 5 step and ruling notes, the outbox, 7 page items; chat headers already sent stay wrong. Triage reads now-central before every stamp; open question for the lane: does the guard run in this session?
